summary: Iteration 10: Full test of FullPreviewModal rewrite — mirrors [id].tsx detail page with fake votes/comments encouragement. All 10 test scenarios PASS. Required Expo restart to clear stale CI=true bundle before new code was visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Metro runs with CI=true in supervisor config — file watching disabled, stale bundle served. Expo restart is required after every main agent file change. This is a known dev-env limitation (noted in iteration 9 as well).
FAKE_VOTES_DATA is static (MOCKED) — 3 hardcoded fake reviews (Marie L., Pierre T., Camille D.) displayed only in preview modal to encourage publishing. These are never sent to the backend.

FAB opacity 0.4 verified visually from screenshots (RN Web inline style for opacity may not be directly queryable via document.querySelectorAll('[style*="opacity"]') due to RN-to-web style compilation).
FullPreviewModal close button uses chevron-back icon (matching [id].tsx navigation style), not X close button — intentional UX improvement matching the target design.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing account user@winek.app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 tested the FullPreviewModal rewrite in create.tsx. All new elements verified: (1) Header with chevron-back (close-full-preview testID) and 'Détails' title + 'Aperçu' badge, (2) Hero image placeholder + ownerBadge overlay (Thomas Dupont / Créateur), (3) Title section with fake rating ★★★★★ 4.7 (12), (4) RSVP row (Rejoindre + 4 participants, disabled), (5) Actions row (Similaires/Partager/Sauvegarder disabled), (6) Map via MapViewComponent, (7) Description section (shows placeholder if no description), (8) Fake votes section — MOCKED static data with FAKE_DIST [8,3,1,0,0], FAKE_RATING=4.7, FAKE_VOTES_COUNT=12, cards for Marie L./Pierre T./Camille D., (9) exampleBanner 'Exemples d avis — publiez pour recevoir de vrais votes !', (10) FAB star at opacity 0.4. Metro CI=true requires expo restart after code changes. testIDs: full-preview-btn, close-full-preview.
